text:
You do not have to feel like following up.

Open the message, type two lines and send it, because the customer cannot tell what mood you were in.

Tell your client the bad news in the same hour you find it.

They can plan around a problem, but they cannot plan around silence.

Your customers will never see the week you almost closed the business.

They only see whether you picked up the phone.

Before you hire someone for a task, do it yourself for a week and write down every step.

If you cannot write the steps down, a new hire cannot follow them, and neither can software.

Ten half built ideas earn you nothing, but one small finished offer can be sold tomorrow morning.

Pick the one closest to done and finish it this week.
